title: 'The possibilities are truly breathtaking': NASA's Roman Space Telescope will take better images and last longer than experts predicted
caption:
NASA’s Roman Space Telescope is performing better than anyone expected. Thanks to precise navigation and mirror tuning, it could stay operational for 20 years instead of 10.

Source: Livescience - 'The possibilities are truly breathtaking': NASA's Roman Space Telescope will take better images and last longer than experts predicted
